title: Connect Us One and All
author: Jasmin Tahmaseb-McConatha Ph.D.
summary: There are also still millions of Americans who are offline. Households without connections are likely to be more disadvantaged with regard to health care, employment opportunities, educational opportunities, and even entertainment.

# Connect Us One and All

> There are also still millions of Americans who are offline. Households without connections are likely to be more disadvantaged with regard to health care, employment opportunities, educational opportunities, and even entertainment.
